triage.instructions: An open item is waiting on Jo's one-word answer, and the orchestrator has recommended an answer. Decide whether Jo's bare `ok` may apply the recommended answer with the other routine items, or whether Jo must decide this item himself. Pick exactly one of the five choices; when in doubt, pick a needs-jo choice.

criteria.routine: the recommended answer follows from the question and its reason, can be undone cheaply, stays inside work Jo already approved, and spends nothing beyond what Jo already set
criteria.needs-jo-irreversible: the recommended answer cannot be undone cheaply: it deletes, publishes, merges, deploys or closes something for good
criteria.needs-jo-product-call: the answer decides what the product does or what Jo wants, not how already-approved work gets done
criteria.needs-jo-cost: the answer spends money or time beyond what Jo set: a raised ceiling, more review rounds, a bigger model or a longer run
criteria.needs-jo-unclear: the question, its options or the recommendation's reason are unclear, or the recommended answer does not follow from them
